title: CLCON/173/2001 of CHOKHEY SINGH Vs MANOJ KUMAR - POLICE MAHA NIRIKSHAK

paras.text:
Court no.3
Contempt Petition no. 173 of 2001
Chokhey Singh and others ------------------------- Petitioners
Versus
Sri Manoj Kumar and others------- Respondents.
Hon'ble Irshad Hussain, J.
This is a contempt petition alleging that the order of the court
passed on 14.3.2001 has not been complied with by the respondents. The
petition was filed with the allegations that the compliance of transfer
order dated 25.5.2000 was not made by the respondents and that the
petitioners were not relieved to the State of Uttar Pradesh. In the petition a
conditional order was passed giving option to the respondents either to
pass fresh transfer order of the petitioners or to relieve the petitioners in
compliance of the earlier transfer order. The petition was filed prior to the
creation of State of Uttaranchal and the instant order was passed on
14.3.2001. Subsequently, as is evident from para no.4 of the counter
affidavit, the order of relieving was cancelled per order dated 26.10.2000
and therefore, there appear either no need to pass fresh order of transfer of
the petitioners from Udham Singh Nagar or to pass the order of
relieving the petitioners to U.P. In the situation like this the question of
non-compliance of order of the court does not arise and the contempt
petition is misconceived.
The contempt petition is dismissed and the notice is discharged.
29.10.2002 (Irshad Hussain, J.)
MPS
